title: Show OSD feedback when switching webcam on and off
line: Pressing a laptop's camera on/off key now shows a "Camera On" or "Camera Off" OSD.
explanation: Since Linux 6.2 the kernel reports camera privacy keys as KEY_CAMERA_ACCESS_ENABLE and KEY_CAMERA_ACCESS_DISABLE (HID usage HUTRR72, also used by drivers such as lenovo-wmi-camera). Qt has no key for them, so they can't be bound as global shortcuts, and nothing in Plasma reacted when they were pressed, unlike the volume, brightness, touchpad or Wi-Fi keys. A new KWin plugin watches the raw key codes with an input spy (the keys still reach applications) and asks plasmashell's OSD service to show "Camera On" or "Camera Off" with the Breeze camera-on/camera-off icons.

commits.message:
plugins: show an OSD for the camera access keys

Laptops and keyboards with a camera privacy key send the kernel's camera
access enable and disable keys, but nothing in Plasma reacted to them. A
new plugin now shows a "Camera On" or "Camera Off" OSD when one is hit.

BUG: 469247

diff --git a/src/plugins/camerakeys/camerakeys.cpp b/src/plugins/camerakeys/camerakeys.cpp
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..0bba14bd4d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/plugins/camerakeys/camerakeys.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-GPL
+*/
+
+#include "camerakeys.h"
+
+#include "input.h"
+#include "input_event.h"
+
+#include <KLocalizedString>
+
+#include <QDBusConnection>
+#include <QDBusMessage>
+#include <QDBusPendingCall>
+
+#include <linux/input-event-codes.h>
+
+namespace KWin
+{
+
+CameraKeys::CameraKeys()
+{
+    input()->installInputEventSpy(this);
+}
+
+void CameraKeys::keyboardKey(KeyboardKeyEvent *event)
+{
+    if (event->state != KeyboardKeyState::Pressed) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    QString icon;
+    QString text;
+    switch (event->nativeScanCode) {
+    case KEY_CAMERA_ACCESS_ENABLE:
+        icon = QStringLiteral("camera-on");
+        text = i18nc("camera was enabled, keep short", "Camera On");
+        break;
+    case KEY_CAMERA_ACCESS_DISABLE:
+        icon = QStringLiteral("camera-off");
+        text = i18nc("camera was disabled, keep short", "Camera Off");
+        break;
+    default:
+        return;
+    }
+
+    QDBusMessage msg = QDBusMessage::createMethodCall(QStringLiteral("org.kde.plasmashell"),
+                                                      QStringLiteral("/org/kde/osdService"),
+                                                      QStringLiteral("org.kde.osdService"),
+                                                      QStringLiteral("showText"));
+    msg.setArguments({icon, text});
+    QDBusConnection::sessionBus().asyncCall(msg);
+}
+
+}
+
+#include "moc_camerakeys.cpp"
